transcription: Can someone tell me the reason why my ex and my classmate disliked me for what I did 15 years ago? When I was in seventh grade, my girlfriend broke up with me because I liked anime. Everyone laughed, including the popular boy, to which I witnessed my girlfriend kiss and date. I was heartbroken, to the point where I stopped being religious because I knew God wouldn't help my problems and make my brain happy. I thought he was all powerful but I guess the atheists are right fast forward to five years later. In around February of 2011, it has been years since I threw all my mango away. My ex broke up with that classmate when high school started I'm no longer that anime boy. The teacher announced that there is a new classmate, that classmate was my ex. We were both 17 at the time and I still hated her. The popular boy was still my classmate. Back to my ex, she kept nagging me, saying she is sorry for what she has done. But I always declined her. She thinks I would eventually forgive her. I never would. My classmate also apologized for what he's done and said it was years ago. He really thought I would forgive him too. I never would so guess what, my revenge? I learned how to hack Facebook accounts from a certain someone. I then hacked their Facebook accounts and decided to look at their private posts. Some of the posts are them drinking alcohol. Some, smoking Zaza I took a look at their comments and saw they insulted multiple kids, including disabled ones I recorded me scrolling to their posts. Then borrowed my neighbor's projector, got my cord to connect my laptop to the projector, waited for next day the next day. I went to my classroom, my classmates are all confused as to why I brought my laptop and projector and shouted everyone I have something to show you while my ex and my classmate kept apologizing. I thought they were faking their apologies. So I played my recording of their private posts and their comments to the entire classroom my ex and my classmate. Their faces went pale. Someone called 911 for their posts. They did get arrested. My ex was still 17. My classmate was 18. I thought to myself that's what my ex gets for betraying my heart and my classmate for stealing my girlfriend in 2006-13 years later. I realized that their apologies were actually serious. I was 30, so I went to my ex and my classmate and jail and told them I forgive them. They said it's too late and had admitted they were confronted multiple times in the shower room by some guys that look so muscular I told them I'm sorry for bringing them to jail like this. But they wouldn't listen, I even asked my ex if she would date me again, she declined, weird, she would always beg me to date her again. Who would have thought my ex and my classmate are immature together because they literally can't forgive me just because of some stupid revenge I did when I was just some dumb teen-
